tools.name: burq_get_estimates
tools.description: Estimate the delivery fee between two ZIP codes for item dimensions, without creating an order. Returns the 10th, 50th and 90th percentile fee in cents, from historical deliveries. Burq API: POST /v2/estimates.

tools.name: burq_check_serviceability
tools.description: Check whether Burq can deliver from a pickup address to a drop-off address. Creates nothing. Returns serviceable: false (still a success) when Burq cannot deliver between the two. Burq API: POST /v2/serviceability.

tools.name: burq_get_order
tools.description: Get the latest state of one order: pickup and drop-off, items, tip, route ids and delivery status. Burq API: GET /v2/orders/{id}.

tools.name: burq_list_routes
tools.description: List delivery routes (multi-stop groups of orders), newest first, with cursor paging. Burq API: GET /v2/routes.

tools.name: burq_get_route
tools.description: Get one route with its orders and stop sequence. Burq API: GET /v2/routes/{route_id}.

tools.name: burq_list_route_quotes
tools.description: List the quotes for a route from the latest quote generation. While quoting is in progress, status is PENDING and data is null. Burq API: GET /v2/routes/{route_id}/quotes.

tools.name: burq_get_route_quote
tools.description: Get one route quote: cost of delivery, Burq fee, provider, courier and pickup time. Burq API: GET /v2/quotes/{id}.

tools.name: burq_create_order
tools.description: Create one delivery order (pickup, drop-off, items). This records an order and books no courier; dispatch is a separate call. Burq API: POST /v2/orders.

tools.name: burq_create_route
tools.description: Group existing orders into one route so it can get quotes and be dispatched. Burq API: POST /v2/routes.

tools.name: burq_generate_route_quotes
tools.description: Start quoting a route with delivery providers. Runs asynchronously; read the result with burq_list_route_quotes. Books no courier. Burq API: POST /v2/routes/{route_id}/quotes.

tools.name: burq_dispatch_route
tools.description: Dispatch a route from a chosen route quote. In production this books a real courier and charges the account. Sandbox creates no real delivery. Send one idempotency_key with the first call and reuse it on any retry, so a lost response cannot book a second courier. Burq API: POST /v2/routes/{route_id}

tools.name: burq_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel the latest delivery of an order. Fails when the driver is already en route. Burq API: POST /v2/orders/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: burq_cancel_route
tools.description: Cancel a route. Runs asynchronously; the outcome arrives by webhook. Burq API: POST /v2/routes/{route_id}/cancel.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: burq_get_estimates, burq_check_serviceability, burq_create_route, burq_generate_route_quotes · Private data: burq_create_order · Public sink: burq_get_estimates, burq_check_serviceability, burq_create_order, burq_create_route, burq_generate_route_quotes, burq_dispatch_route, burq_cancel_order, burq_cancel_route · Destructive: burq_check_serviceability, burq_get_order, burq_create_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: burq_get_estimates, burq_check_serviceability, burq_create_route, burq_generate_route_quotes · Private data: burq_create_order · Public sink: burq_get_estimates, burq_check_serviceability, burq_create_order, burq_create_route, burq_generate_route_quotes, burq_dispatch_route, burq_cancel_order, burq_cancel_route · Destructive: burq_check_serviceability, burq_get_order, burq_create_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
